policy: S2x curated local rotations, not the retail ordering algorithm. Daily Orders and Contracts reset at 17:00 UTC; Weekly Orders reset Tuesday at 17:00 UTC. Each mode offers 6 Daily, 3 Weekly and 9 Contracts, with 3 active per category. Captured targets/reward promises are retained, including backend overrides of table defaults. Entries marked local_rare_zombies_drop use native table targets/predicates/tokens/timers and a local reward of one Rare Zombies Drop; their retail reward values were not recovered. Descriptions and objective evaluation use native tables. Cohort/randomizer-gated MP variants are excluded so stock menus show the same set for every player. Ungated native replacements marked local_200_armory_credits award 200 Armory Credits; their retail reward values were not recovered. MP Special Orders use one daily offer and one active slot; accepted Orders have no expiry. The curated cycle contains ten one-time base-weapon unlocks and twenty-nine repeatable bribe offers. Targets come from native tables, and bribe types/bundle quantities follow native reward text; an unquantified single-bribe offer grants one. Base-weapon and bribe item mappings are marked local_base_weapon/local_native_bribe because the original backend product descriptors were not recovered. Bribes may be accepted again only in a later offered period. Historical reissues, unsupported St. Patrick's bribes, unnamed premium-bribe rewards, Zombies Special Orders and non-match-count objectives are omitted.
